acquisition_method.evidence: Eluting peptides were analyzed in the mass spectrometer using data independent acquisition (DIA) mode.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Tryptic digestion of proteins (Input: 10 µg) was performed using an AssayMAP Bravo liquid handling system (Agilent technologies) running the autoSP3 protocol according to Müller et al. (Muller, Kalxdorf et al. 2020).

collision_energy.evidence: A full scan at 120k resolution (380-1400 m/z, 300% AGC target, 45 ms maxIT) was followed by 47 MS2 windows covering the mass range from 400-1000 m/z with variable width and overlapping by 1 Da (30k resolution, AGC target 1000%, maxIT 54 ms, 28% HCD collision energy).
